payoutsPage.heading: Payouts
payoutsPage.manualNotice: Manually recorded by Unity — no automated provider is connected
payoutsPage.emptyDesc: A payout is created automatically once a rental completes.

statusExplanations.pending: Unity has created your payout record. It has not started processing yet.
statusExplanations.processing: Unity is processing this payout. No automated payout provider is currently connected.
statusExplanations.paid: Unity recorded this payout as paid.
statusExplanations.failed: This payout could not be completed. Unity will review or retry it.

payoutsPage.footerNotice: Payouts are recorded manually by Unity while no automated payout provider is connected.

becomeAffiliate.heading: Become an Affiliate
becomeAffiliate.description: Earn commission on completed rentals and sales you refer, only on listings the merchant has specifically enabled. Barter trades never earn commission.
becomeAffiliate.noApproval: No approval needed — activate instantly and start earning today.
becomeAffiliate.shareLinksDesc: for any listing that accepts affiliates
becomeAffiliate.earnCommissionDesc: on completed eligible sales or rentals

affiliateProgram.heading: Affiliate Program
affiliateProgram.codeNotice: Browse affiliate-enabled listings below and copy your share link — commission is only earned on listings the merchant has enabled, and never on barter trades.
affiliateProgram.noCommissionsInCategory: No commissions in this category yet.
affiliateProgram.footerNotice: Commissions are processed automatically after a short review period.

affiliateManagement.heading: Affiliates
affiliateManagement.infoNotice: Enable affiliates per listing below. Commission is only charged on completed eligible sales or rental payments — never on deposits, refunds, or barter trades. Affiliate payouts are handled automatically by Unity on your behalf.
affiliateManagement.footerNotice: The commission rate for each listing is set in the listing editor.
affiliateManagement.learnMore: Learn more about the Ambassador program →

rtbTerms.heading: Rent-to-Buy Terms
rtbTerms.enabledNotice: Rent-to-buy is enabled for this listing.
rtbTerms.disabledNotice: Rent-to-buy is not yet enabled for this listing.
rtbTerms.ownershipNotice: You remain the owner of the item until the customer has paid the full amount below.
rtbTerms.securityDeposit: Security deposit (ZAR, optional — never counts toward the purchase price)
rtbTerms.allowEarlyPayoff: Allow the customer to pay off the remaining balance early
rtbTerms.allowCure: Allow the customer to cure a default and resume the agreement

pricing.heading: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subheading: No monthly fee to get started. Upgrade any time for lower commission rates and unlimited listings. Barter trades never carry a commission, on any plan.
pricing.footerNotice: Commission is charged only on completed sales and rentals. Downgrades and cancellations take effect at the start of your next billing period; upgrades apply immediately.

ambassadors.metaDescription: Earn commission referring new renters and merchants to Unity.
ambassadors.heroDescription: Refer merchants to the Unity platform and earn commission on every rental they complete — for as long as they list with us.
ambassadors.noCostNotice: No cost to join · Payouts monthly via Warp

apply.title: Apply via Warp

getLink.title: Get your link
getLink.desc: Receive a unique referral link you can share anywhere — social, WhatsApp, email.

refer.title: Refer merchants
refer.desc: Merchants who sign up through your link and list items are tracked automatically.

earn.title: Earn commission
earn.desc: Get a percentage of every completed rental made via listings you referred.

ambassadors.tierBasisNotice: Your tier is based on total active merchants you've referred. Upgrades happen automatically.

type.sellDesc: One-time purchase — the buyer pays once and keeps the item.

basics.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe your item — what's included, its condition, any accessories, and anything a renter should know…

errors.titleTooShort: Title must be at least 10 characters
errors.descriptionTooShort: Description must be at least 50 characters

photos.heading: Item photos (minimum 3)
photos.desc: Upload clear photos from different angles. The first photo is the cover image — use the star button to change it.
photos.dropzoneTitle: Click to upload or drag & drop
photos.dropzoneHint: JPG, PNG, WEBP — up to 10MB each
photos.damagePhotoNotice: One of the photos above clearly shows the damage/defects described earlier — required since defects were declared.

errors.damagePhotoRequired: A damage close-up photo is required since defects were declared in the previous step

ownership.whyBody: Ownership proof protects both you and renters. It's reviewed by Unity within 24 hours. Accepted: purchase receipt, serial number photo, warranty card, or short video of the item.
ownership.dropzoneHint: JPG, PNG, PDF, MP4 — up to 50MB
ownership.knownDefectsPlaceholder: Describe any existing damage, wear, or missing parts a renter should know about…
ownership.knownDefectsNotice: Unity does not allow hiding known defects — disclosed items still rent, undisclosed ones risk disputes.
ownership.confirmLabel: I confirm that the condition and defects described are accurate.

errors.confirmRequired: Please confirm the condition and defects described are accurate

pricing.insuranceHint: Charged to the renter per day. Leave blank to skip.

blockedDates.desc: Dates this item is unavailable to book (maintenance, personal use, etc.).

errors.chooseDates: Choose both a start and end date
errors.startBeforeEnd: Start date must be before the end date
errors.overlap: This range overlaps an existing blocked range

errors.availabilityStartRequired: Please choose an availability start date
errors.maxLessThanMin: Maximum rental duration cannot be less than the minimum

requirements.infoNotice: Set the minimum bar for renters. If a renter doesn't meet your requirements, they'll see a clear message explaining why before they can book.
requirements.unityScoreDesc: Only renters with this score or above can book
requirements.depositDesc: Authorized at checkout and released when the item comes back undamaged
requirements.riskTierDesc: Assigned automatically by Unity's Risk Engine from category, price, and your merchant standing — this can't be changed manually.
requirements.riskManualReview: Requires manual review by Unity before going live
requirements.riskNoRequirements: No deposit or ownership verification required

errors.licenceClassRequired: Licence class is required when a driving licence is required

affiliates.infoNotice: When affiliates are enabled, other Unity members can share your listing with a referral link. You pay them a commission only on completed rentals — no upfront cost.
affiliates.acceptAffiliatesDesc: Allow others to refer renters to this listing
affiliates.commissionRateHint: 1–50%. Commission is deducted from your rental fee after the booking is completed.

review.submitNotice: Submitting sends your listing for review — it won't go live until Unity confirms it meets the requirements for its risk tier. You can save as a draft and come back any time before then.

errors.notSignedIn: You must be signed in to save a listing
